#!/bin/bash
set -eo pipefail

# Environment
source /etc/network_turbo
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base
export HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache
export HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET=1
export REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
export SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0

MODELS="/root/entrainment_gated_ft/models"
RESULTS="/root/entrainment_gated_ft/results/exp005_zoo_expansion"
LOG="$RESULTS/priority1_v4.log"

echo "=== P1 v4 START $(date) ===" | tee "$LOG"

# Verify fla
python3 -c "import fla; print('fla OK:', fla.__version__)" 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG"

# Download DeltaNet if needed
if [ ! -f "$MODELS/340M-20B-DeltaNet-hybrid-3-1/model.safetensors" ]; then
  echo "=== Downloading DeltaNet h3-1 $(date) ===" | tee -a "$LOG"
  python3 -c "
import os
os.environ['HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET'] = '1'
from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
snapshot_download(
    'm-a-p/340M-20B-DeltaNet-hybrid-3-1',
    local_dir='$MODELS/340M-20B-DeltaNet-hybrid-3-1'
)
print('DeltaNet download complete')
" 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG"
else
  echo "DeltaNet already present" | tee -a "$LOG"
fi

# Download HGRN if needed
if [ ! -f "$MODELS/340M-20B-HGRN-hybrid-3-1/model.safetensors" ]; then
  echo "=== Downloading HGRN h3-1 $(date) ===" | tee -a "$LOG"
  python3 -c "
import os
os.environ['HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET'] = '1'
from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
snapshot_download(
    'm-a-p/340M-20B-HGRN-hybrid-3-1',
    local_dir='$MODELS/340M-20B-HGRN-hybrid-3-1'
)
print('HGRN download complete')
" 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG"
else
  echo "HGRN already present" | tee -a "$LOG"
fi

# Verify all 3 models exist
echo "=== Verifying models ===" | tee -a "$LOG"
for ARCH in GLA DeltaNet HGRN; do
  if [ -f "$MODELS/340M-20B-${ARCH}-hybrid-3-1/model.safetensors" ]; then
    echo "  $ARCH: OK ($(du -sh $MODELS/340M-20B-${ARCH}-hybrid-3-1/model.safetensors | cut -f1))" | tee -a "$LOG"
  else
    echo "  $ARCH: MISSING!" | tee -a "$LOG"
    exit 1
  fi
done

# Evaluate each model
for ARCH in GLA DeltaNet HGRN; do
  LOCAL="$MODELS/340M-20B-${ARCH}-hybrid-3-1"
  OUTDIR="$RESULTS/${ARCH}_hybrid-3-1"

  # Skip if already evaluated (check for jsonl output)
  if find "$OUTDIR" -name "*.jsonl" 2>/dev/null | head -1 | grep -q .; then
    echo "=== $ARCH already evaluated, skipping ===" | tee -a "$LOG"
    continue
  fi

  echo "=== EVAL $ARCH START $(date) ===" | tee -a "$LOG"
  python3 -m lm_eval \
    --model hf \
    --model_args pretrained=$LOCAL,trust_remote_code=True \
    --tasks lambada_openai,arc_easy \
    --device cuda:0 \
    --batch_size auto \
    --log_samples \
    --output_path "$OUTDIR/" 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG"
  echo "=== EVAL $ARCH DONE $(date) ===" | tee -a "$LOG"
done

echo "=== P1 v4 ALL DONE $(date) ===" | tee "$LOG.done"
echo "=== P1 v4 ALL DONE $(date) ===" | tee -a "$LOG"

# Summary
echo "" | tee -a "$LOG"
echo "=== RESULTS SUMMARY ===" | tee -a "$LOG"
find "$RESULTS" -name "*.jsonl" -type f 2>/dev/null | tee -a "$LOG"
SCRIPT_EOF
chmod +x /root/entrainment_gated_ft/results/exp005_zoo_expansion/run_p1_v4.sh
echo "Script written OK"
